summary_en: Circlace corrected its October 22 disclosure regarding HHH1 LLC's public tender offer. The correction clarified that board approval was obtained from unaffiliated directors who attended the meeting, not all unaffiliated directors, and audit committee members raised no objections.
title_en: Correction Notice Regarding "Notice of Opinion in Support of and Recommendation to Tender in Public Tender Offer for Our Share Certificates by HHH1 LLC"
translation_en_brief:
On November 20, 2026, Circlace Inc. issued a correction notice to its October 22, 2026 disclosure regarding HHH1 LLC's public tender offer for the company's shares. The correction addresses an error in the record of directors who attended the October 22 board meeting.

The corrected disclosure clarifies that board approval for the company's endorsement of the tender offer and recommendation that shareholders tender their shares was obtained from all unaffiliated directors who attended the meeting, rather than stating all unaffiliated directors without qualification. The company notes that of its seven directors, five participated in deliberation and resolution after two directors (Seamus McHugh and Koichi Itabashi) were excluded due to conflicts of interest. All five participating directors unanimously approved the resolution. Additionally, all three audit committee members attended the meeting and expressed no objections to the resolution.

The correction also clarifies that regarding subscription rights with a purchase price of 1 yen, holders' decision to tender is left to their own discretion. This correction addresses a technical clarification rather than a substantive change to the board's support for the tender offer.
